plugins.name: switchboard
plugins.description: /mods opens a panel that lists every installed mod with an on/off toggle; new installs appear on their own.

plugins.name: brain-dump
plugins.description: Turns long, messy prompts into a structured task, why, guardrails and definition of done after a few clarifying questions.

plugins.name: cache-warm
plugins.description: Keeps the prompt cache warm: a band above the prompt counts down the cache's life and pings it with a tiny forked request just before it lapses, so the next reply reads the context at a fraction of the price.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Packages the session's goal, files, skills, tools and links into a prompt for a fresh chat, offered at 250k tokens or when the cache has likely gone cold.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Spots a lasting rule in a prompt you type and, after Claude's reply, asks where to save it: auto memory or a CLAUDE.md file.

plugins.name: screen-share
plugins.description: Screen-share mode: names, emails, phone numbers and amounts draw as shaded bars on screen while Claude still reads the real data.

plugins.name: theme-cli
plugins.description: Pixel-art characters run along a strip above the prompt while Claude works, one extra companion per running subagent, and a flagpole finale when the task completes. Themes are folders of your own images in ~/.claude/theme-cli/themes, switched with /theme-use. Terminal only.
